source.state: Uncommitted grouped-delivery implementation on the stated base; identical before and after the pair. This fingerprint records the measured source, not later documentation or review repairs.

method.sessions: Two fresh in-memory AgentSessions with the same assignment as systemPrompt, model, thinking and custom tools. Builtin tools, context files, skills, external extensions, templates and themes disabled; only the controlled inline extension loaded.
method.reports:
Supply F0 through F9 sequentially. Team review-comparison; names reader-0 through reader-9; run IDs fixture-run-0 through fixture-run-9. Persist each report with source read-agent, runtime status completed, reported outcome succeeded, summary equal to claim, and one finding with id, text 'Control: <control>. <claim>', evidence [reference]. Full report text is 'Report ID: <runtime report ID>
' followed by corpus.report.
method.immediateFull: After each stored report append, call Pi sendMessage with customType pi-extended-teams-report, content equal to full stored report, details {name, elapsedMs: 0, tokens: 0, ok: true}, display false, triggerTurn true and deliverAs followUp. Those fixture detail values are not measured token or timing evidence.
method.allSettledCompact: Create and seal an all-settled CompletionGroup with ten reader slots before submitting reports. Bind each actual fixture run, append the report with top-level completionGroup binding, call deliverCompletionGroupReport, then requestCompletionGroupWake for unread indexes. The inline context handler calls observeCompletionGroupWakes on SDK session entries.
method.timing: performance.now from immediately before the sequential report loop through the final agent_settled event with all requested custom messages inserted and a valid synthesis. Session setup is outside this interval.
method.usage: Sum actual assistant-message usage.input, cacheRead, cacheWrite and output separately. Count modelRuntime.streamSimple invocations, wrapped HTTP fetches, sendMessage wake invocations and actual agent_settled events separately.
method.failurePolicy: No automatic retry, fallback or repeated synthesis attempt. Abort on invalid synthesis, model error, missing synthesis at settlement, request limit or deadline. Runtime fixtures removed only after abort/dispose; no live user session modified.

toolCatalog.name: read_report
toolCatalog.description: Read a complete saved report by its exact report ID.
toolCatalog.behavior: Return exact readStoredTeamReportEvent(team, reportId).report as text and details {reportId}; reject an unknown ID. Harness-only tool, not a new public extension tool.

toolCatalog.name: submit_synthesis
toolCatalog.description: Submit all ten report control codes, pending acceptance and the exact interrupted-assignment reason. An incorrect submission stops this comparison without a retry.
toolCatalog.behavior: Require exactly the corpus findingId/control pairs after sorting, acceptance pending and the exact requiredInterruptedReason. Return text 'Accepted. Say only Done and stop.' and details {accepted: true}. Harness-only tool; does not grant lead acceptance.

assignment: Synthesize ten supplied source-backed review reports F0 through F9 about grouped report delivery. Each supplies an explicit Control code. Once all ten reports are available, call submit_synthesis with all ten findingId/control pairs, acceptance pending, and the EXACT persisted reason string for a lost unadmitted assignment described in F9 (without surrounding quotes). Use read_report with the supplied report ID if a compact index omits necessary detail. Do not invent evidence, infer approval, investigate new issues, or ask questions. Until enough reports arrive, say only Waiting for remaining reports. After submit_synthesis is accepted, say only Done. No other work is authorized.
requiredInterruptedReason: Assignment was not retained across extension reload; no work was restarted.
corpusHashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(corpus), preserving object-key and array order

corpus.claim: An omitted completion-group policy does not enable grouping.
The durable group creates fixed pending slots from the accepted assignment.
A run is bound only to its slot and an incompatible replacement run is rejected.
The existing report receipt cannot be replaced by a conflicting result.
Runtime failure or failed/stale verification can qualify urgently without rewriting the reported outcome.
Suppressed members settle but cannot contribute visible delivery evidence.
A durable wake reservation precedes request execution and ambiguous requests cannot reserve again.
The compact index includes an independently stored full-report reference and separates outcome, verification and acceptance.
Exact observed SDK history is distinct from provider success; another team's entry cannot acknowledge this group.
Lost unadmitted assignments become interrupted; unknown running ownership is not restarted or declared successful.

limitations: One fixed-order pair, not randomized or repeated statistics. Provider caches and scheduling can affect another run.
Reports were supplied, not generated by newly spawned specialists. Child token use and independent review quality were not measured.
The controlled two-tool catalog is not the full production tool catalog. Results do not establish general end-to-end review-speed savings.
Wake requests, model/HTTP calls, assistant responses and actual agent_settled events are different observations.
Separate offline scripted SDK smokes exercise message/history/retrieval/reload plumbing, not actual token usage. Their timings are not the live-pair measurements above.
No full spawned admission-to-teardown, process-restart, physical power-loss or live Herdr guarantee. No raw session histories, request contexts or credentials included.
